state:
- Novelty remains unresolved: DHODH-driven differentiation and salvage bypass are established premises. Check teriflunomide/leflunomide–AML prior art and identify a genuinely untested prediction attributable to adaptive, demand-adjusted salvage in residual AML.
- R(t) risks repackaging its defining endpoint—pyrimidine depletion after DHODH challenge. Specify flux estimation, standardize reference-inhibitor engagement, account for residual de novo synthesis, and test incremental predictive utility over depletion alone; this tests biomarker novelty, not whether salvage biology is valid.
- Reciprocal salvage perturbations, lineage-confirmed maturation and mechanism-specific falsifiers provide exceptional specificity, but execution gates remain qualitative. Populate the proposed exposure gate with verified numerical bounds, practical schedules, assay criteria and donor-level go/no-go effect sizes.
